text:
Rosa (Finance): Quick update on BridgeTech (BT-442) invoice 22451 — customer replied and agreed to a 30% immediate payment but insists we provide a line-item usage export and remove a $3,200 tax adjustment they say is incorrect. ACH is scheduled for 48h.
Ajay Patel: good, mark in the ledger as 'pending partial' once ACH hits. If ACH fails again we trigger the credit hold plan at 17:00 PST. please flag for reconciliation.
Marta Li: shared the CSV usage export in a follow-up DM (detailed per-endpoint calls + token buckets). they asked for a short reconciliation call before signing the installment docs.
Collections Bot: Auto-note: invoice 22451 flagged as 'partial promise' 195. Next automated reminder suppressed while legal template is pending.
Jordan (Legal Ops): I'll draft a short-form installment agreement that includes: 1) payment schedule (30% now, 35% in 30d, 35% in 60d), 2) interest 1.5% p/month on unpaid balance, 3) accuracy recourse limited to 14 days after first payment. sending draft by EOD.
Rosa (Finance): can we remove late fee if they pay 30% now and sign the agreement within 48h? that's our concession threshold.
Jordan (Legal Ops): OK to waive one-time late fee on condition of signed installment agreement and proof of ACH clearance. I'll add explicit clause: 'waiver effective only upon receipt of initial payment'.
Ajay Patel: ops detail: payments-team, heads up  once first ACH clears, please run a manual verify against the bank trace and set status to PARTIAL_PAID. Also hold webhook keys per Marta's note (only non-prod keys pause).
payments-team: ack. We'll watch for ACH trace and set the ledger flag. If returned, we'll tag with return code and auto-escalate to manager.
Marta Li: customer also requested we pause rate-limited endpoints to avoid new usage while they reconcile. suggested pause scope: write/generate endpoints only, keep embeddings for internal tooling.
Rosa (Finance): agree to pause non-critical endpoints if we have the signed agreement. no pause until 30% shows.
Collections Bot: Escalation status: manager outreach required if no signed agreement + payment within 72h. Template email queued: 'installment offer + usage export attached'.
Jordan (Legal Ops): attaching sample clause I'm sending to them: ```If Customer remits the initial installment within 48 hours and executes this Agreement, Redwood Inference will defer late fees and suspend access restrictions to production read-only APIs. Failure to remit subsequent installments within 5 days of due date will accelerate the balance.```
Ajay Patel: note for accounting: classify initial receipt as 'Customer prepayment - installment' so revenue recognition team can track deferred revenue.
Marta Li: I've scheduled the reconcile call for 3/4 11:00 PST (tentative). will include the account director.
Rosa (Finance): action items: Jordan to send agreement (EOD), payments-team to monitor ACH, Ajay to set ledger status on payment, Marta to run usage walk-through with client. I'll update CRM and remove next auto-dunning once signed. :white_check_mark:
payments-team: will monitor and post trace here.
Rosa (Finance): thanks everyone. drop any inbound messages into this thread. if they push back on the tax line, we'll escalate to tax counsel.
Marta Li: customer note (excerpt): 'We can start with 30% today. Need the usage CSV and confirmation we won't face service cuts while we reconcile.'
Rosa (Finance): replied: 'We'll proceed on the terms above; send signed agreement and payment receipt to avoid holds.'
